restaurantName: La Table de Marc Tupin - Hostellerie Saint-Germain
bio: Opposite the church, this engaging 17C coaching inn has been entirely refurbished in a low-key, contemporary vein. The chef sources fine local produce, often organic, to craft appetising dishes, occasionally peppered with creative touches, such as pink trout and nori seaweed. All of which is washed down with fine Jura wines. The cosy rooms are pleasant, and quieter overlooking the terrace.
pageTitle: La Table de Marc Tupin - Hostellerie Saint-Germain
